query:
INSERT INTO core.structure_names (structure_id, name, solar_system_id, type_id)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
        ON CONFLICT (structure_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name,
            solar_system_id = EXCLUDED.solar_system_id, type_id = EXCLUDED.type_id,
            read_at = now()
